title: VEGETATION MONITORING AND ANALYSIS
session_html: Super Term (Term Extension + Full Term) (09-09-2026 to 12-04-2026)
description: Describe techniques and methods used to measure, monitor and analyze vegetation attributes and natural resource data in shrubland, grassland, and forest ecosystems. Topics include sampling principles and design; protocol development; inventory and monitoring; field methods; analysis, evaluation and interpretation of resource data. Field-oriented course, emphasizing both theory and practice.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ((BI 221 or 221H) and (BI 222 or 222H) and (BI 223 or 223H)) or ((BI 221Z or 221HZ) and (BI 222Z or 222HZ) and (BI 223Z or 223HZ)) or (BI 204, 205 and 206).
A minimum grade of D is required in BI 221, BI 221H, BI 222, BI 222H, BI 223, BI 223H, BI 221Z, BI 221HZ, BI 222Z, BI 222HZ, BI 223Z, BI 223HZ, BI 204, BI 205 and BI 206.

Enrollment limited to students in the Oregon State - Corvallis campus.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. Required field week Sept. 14th-18th 8am-5pm.
